$comment: Maggioli SVG sources that belong to svg-icons only and are deliberately absent from the
icon font. They were authored for iconsauce, which reads svg-icons/dist directly, so they
are reachable through <mds-icon> and were never requested in this package.
This is a declaration of intent, not a backlog: an entry here says the choice was made.
If one of these is ever needed in the font, it gets its own pull request.
scripts/check-dictionary.ts fails on an unmapped source that is listed neither here nor in
dictionary.json, so a new source cannot slip through without someone deciding either way.
Note on 'judge-hammer': the dictionary key of that name already points to mdi/gavel, so
mapping the Maggioli source would need a different key.
